name: motion-gltf-clips
title: glTF animation clips
description: A glTF file's animation clips read as written: each channel's target node, path, interpolation, key times and values as the accessors hold them; a channel's value at t by the glTF 2.0 spec (STEP, LINEAR with slerp for rotation, CUBICSPLINE Hermite with the file's tangents); skins and morph targets reported as present
